quindi.es: por tanto; así que; por consiguiente

texto: **Piove, quindi prendiamo l'ombrello** (Rain, therefore we take the umbrella) in front of * Prendiamo l'ombrello perché piove *.

**Anche se piove, esco senza fretta** (Although it rains, I leave without haste); **Il treno è perfetto: infatti arriva sempre in perfetto orario** (The train is perfect: it always comes with British punctuality).

filas: Il tragitto è lungo, quindi partiamo presto.
The journey is long, so we leave early.
Ha studiato molto: infatti ha superato l'esame.
He has studied a lot: he has actually approved the test.
Anche se fa freddo, facciamo una passeggiata.
Even if it's cold, we take a walk.
Possiamo cenare a casa oppure andare in pizzeria.
We can have dinner at home or go to a pizzeria.

frases.it: C'è molto traffico in autostrada, quindi propongo di prendere il treno regionale.
frases.es: Hay mucho tráfico en la autopista, por tanto propongo coger el tren regional.
frases.en: There's a lot of traffic on the highway, so I propose to take the regional train.

frases.it: Hai ragione. Infatti il treno impiega la metà del tempo nelle ore di punta.
frases.es: Tienes razón. De hecho el tren tarda la mitad de tiempo en hora punta.
frases.en: You're right. In fact, the train takes half the time in the rush hour.
analisis: The train actually takes a while.

frases.it: E anche se il biglietto costa un euro in più, viaggiamo comodi e rilassati.
frases.es: Y aunque el billete cueste un euro más, viajamos cómodos y relajados.
frases.en: And even if the ticket costs one more euro, we travel comfortable and relaxed.
analisis: and even if the ticket costs

frases.it: Benissimo! Possiamo leggere qualcosa oppure riposare durante il viaggio.
frases.es: ¡Estupendo! Podemos leer algo o bien descansar durante el viaje.
frases.en: Great! We can read something or rest on the trip.

bloques.pregunta: What logical role does «quindi» play in Luca's proposal?

opciones.texto: Consequence deduced from the premise of the roadside traffic.
opciones.explicacion: «Quindi» acts as a conclusive ilative connector («por consiguiente»).

opciones.texto: Condición hipotética irrealizable en el presente.
opciones.explicacion: It does not express subjunctive condition with «se».

opciones.texto: Oposición tajante a los deseos de su interlocutora.
opciones.explicacion: It does not introduce any contradictory objection.

bloques.frase: Ha piovuto tutta la notte, ___ le strade della collina sono scivolose.

opciones.explicacion: It links the fall rain with the logical consequence of the slippery asphalt.
It would mean «though», distorting the direct causal relationship.
I'd plant an absurd disjunctive between the rain and the streets.

bloques.frase: Anche se il tragitto è lungo, preferisco viaggiare in treno per riposare.

opciones.texto: Although the tour is long, I place the comfort of the train before I rest.
opciones.explicacion: Faithful reflection of the concessional subordinate prayer with «anche se».

opciones.texto: As the journey is extremely short, I disagree to get on the regional train.
opciones.explicacion: Reverse the concessional value and alter the duration of the trip.

opciones.texto: Since the train was damaged, I continued my car route.
opciones.explicacion: Introduce non-existing incidents in the original sentence.

bloques.pregunta: What discursive connector provides a probative confirmation of the above?

opciones.explicacion: Corrobates the previous assertion with a conclusive data or fact («in fact»).
It expresses only a disjunctive or alternative between options.
Formal concessional connector that requires subjunctive.

bloques.frase: Possiamo prendere il treno oppure l'autobus
bloques.traduccion: We can take the train or the bus.
bloques.explicacion: Order the phrase with the explicit alternative.

bloques.frase: Il servizio postale è molto efficiente: ___ la lettera è arrivata in sole ventiquattr'ore.

opciones.explicacion: It provides the factual and evidentiary confirmation of the effectiveness of the service.
It would offer a meaningless alternative to the arrival of the letter.

bloques.pregunta: What difference does «anche se» make from concessional connectors such as «sebbene» or «benché»?

opciones.texto: «Anche se» rige habitualmente modo indicativo, mientras que «sebbene» exige subjuntivo.
opciones.explicacion: Critical modal distinction at the B1 level of Italian.

opciones.texto: «Anche se» can only be used at the end of the main sentence.
opciones.explicacion: False: can be freely preceded or postponed.

opciones.texto: «Anche se» prohibits the use of verbs in past time.
opciones.explicacion: It is used in the present, past and future without restriction.

intro: The logical connectors articulate the ideas in the discourse by giving consistency to reasoning: **quindi** introduces logical consequences, **infatti** confirms or justifies a prior assertion, **anche se** provides concession and **oppure** offers disjunctives.
